dict.string: Yap records the audio from your meeting — the other people on the call as well as you — so it can write the notes. Recording stays on your Mac.
Yap pastes transcribed text into the app you're typing in.
Yap uses the microphone when you start dictation or record a meeting, and transcribes on this Mac.
Yap reads your calendars on this Mac — including Google or Exchange accounts already added to macOS Calendar — to name and prepare your meetings. Read-only; nothing leaves your Mac.
